name: data-table-06
description: A searchable table with status and plan filters, a column menu, page sizes and row selection to export or email.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { createDataTableColumnHelper, createDataTableSelectColumn, DataTableContent, DataTableFacetFilter, type DataTableFacetOption, DataTablePagination, DataTableReset, DataTableSearch, DataTableSelectionBar, DataTableViewOptions, useDataTable, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/data-table' import { Details } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/details' import { StatusLabel, type StatusTone, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/status-label' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { formatCurrency } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' type CustomerPlan = 'Enterprise' | 'Free' | 'Pro' | 'Team' type CustomerStatus = 'active' | 'churned' | 'past-due' | 'trial' interface CustomerRow { company: string email: string id: string /** Monthly recurring revenue, in dollars. */ mrr: number plan: CustomerPlan seats: number /** ISO date. */ signedUp: string status: CustomerStatus } interface DataTable6Props { /** Defaults to a sentence counting the accounts and what they pay. */ description?: string onEmail?: (rows: CustomerRow[]) => void onExport?: (rows: CustomerRow[]) => void pageSize?: number /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ rows?: CustomerRow[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const COMPANIES = [ ['Northwind', 'northwind.io'], ['Brightpath', 'brightpath.dev'], ['Loop Studio', 'loop.studio'], ['Fieldnotes', 'fieldnotes.co'], ['Harbor', 'harbor.app'], ['Quanta', 'quanta.ai'], ['Pinecrest', 'pinecrest.com'], ['Juniper Labs', 'juniperlabs.io'], ['Sable', 'sable.so'], ['Kitefin', 'kitefin.com'], ['Mosaic', 'mosaic.design'], ['Arcadia', 'arcadia.health'], ['Tidewater', 'tidewater.co'], ['Emberly', 'emberly.app'], ['Cobalt', 'cobalt.sh'], ['Wren & Co', 'wren.co'], ['Lumen', 'lumen.fm'], ['Orbital', 'orbital.dev'], ['Parcel', 'parcel.shop'], ['Stackwise', 'stackwise.io'], ['Verdant', 'verdant.farm'], ['Halcyon', 'halcyon.travel'], ] const PLANS: CustomerPlan[] = ['Pro', 'Team', 'Free', 'Pro', 'Enterprise', 'Team', 'Pro'] const STATUSES: CustomerStatus[] = [ 'active', 'active', 'trial', 'active', 'past-due', 'active', 'churned', 'trial', ] const SEAT_PRICE: Record = { Enterprise: 45, Free: 0, Pro: 12, Team: 24, } const exampleProps: DataTable6Props = { pageSize: 8, rows: COMPANIES.map(([company, domain], index) => { const plan = PLANS[index % PLANS.length] const status = STATUSES[(index * 3) % STATUSES.length] const seats = plan === 'Free' ? 1 + (index % 3) : 3 + ((index * 7) % 38) const month = String(1 + ((index * 5) % 12)).padStart(2, '0') const day = String(1 + ((index * 11) % 28)).padStart(2, '0') return { company, email: `billing@${domain}`, id: `cus_${(1_042 + index * 37).toString(36)}`, mrr: status === 'churned' || status === 'trial' ? 0 : seats * SEAT_PRICE[plan], plan, seats, signedUp: `${index % 3 === 0 ? 2024 : 2025}-${month}-${day}`, status, } }), title: 'Customers', } const STATUS_CONFIG: Record = { active: { label: 'Active', tone: 'good' }, churned: { label: 'Churned', tone: 'neutral' }, 'past-due': { label: 'Past due', tone: 'bad' }, trial: { label: 'Trial', tone: 'info' }, } const STATUS_OPTIONS: DataTableFacetOption[] = ( ['active', 'trial', 'past-due', 'churned'] as const ).map((status) => ({ label: STATUS_CONFIG[status].label, value: status })) const PLAN_OPTIONS: DataTableFacetOption[] = ['Free', 'Pro', 'Team', 'Enterprise'].map( (plan) => ({ label: plan, value: plan }), ) const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC', year: 'numeric', }) const summarize = (rows: CustomerRow[]) => { const paying = rows.filter((row) => row.mrr > 0) const total = paying.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.mrr, 0) const accounts = `${rows.length} ${rows.length === 1 ? 'account' : 'accounts'}` return `${accounts}, ${paying.length} of them paying ${formatCurrency(total)} a month.` } const CSV_COLUMNS: (keyof CustomerRow)[] = [ 'id', 'company', 'email', 'status', 'plan', 'seats', 'mrr', 'signedUp', ] // Spreadsheets run a cell that starts with one of these as a formula, and names and emails come from your customers. const FORMULA_START = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/ const csvCell = (value: string | number) => { const text = typeof value === 'string' && FORMULA_START.test(value) ? `'${value}` : String(value) return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : text } const downloadCsv = (rows: CustomerRow[]) => { const csv = [CSV_COLUMNS, ...rows.map((row) => CSV_COLUMNS.map((key) => row[key]))] .map((line) => line.map(csvCell).join(',')) .join('\n') const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' })) const link = document.createElement('a') link.href = url link.download = 'customers.csv' link.click() URL.revokeObjectURL(url) } const openMailto = (rows: CustomerRow[]) => { window.location.href = `mailto:?bcc=${rows.map((row) => row.email).join(',')}` } const noRows: CustomerRow[] = [] const columnHelper = createDataTableColumnHelper() const columns = columnHelper.columns([ createDataTableSelectColumn({ getRowLabel: (row) => row.company }), columnHelper.accessor('company', { cell: ({ row }) => ( <> {row.original.company} {row.original.email} ), enableHiding: false, header: 'Customer', meta: { primary: true, truncate: true }, }), columnHelper.accessor('status', { cell: ({ getValue }) => { const status = STATUS_CONFIG[getValue()] return {status.label} }, enableGlobalFilter: false, enableSorting: false, header: 'Status', meta: { cellClassName: 'whitespace-nowrap' }, }), columnHelper.accessor('plan', { cell: ({ row }) => (
{row.original.plan} {`${row.original.seats} ${row.original.seats === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats'}`}
), header: 'Plan', meta: { cellClassName: 'whitespace-nowrap' }, }), columnHelper.accessor('seats', { enableGlobalFilter: false, header: 'Seats', meta: { align: 'end' }, }), columnHelper.accessor('mrr', { cell: ({ getValue }) => formatCurrency(getValue()), enableGlobalFilter: false, header: 'MRR', meta: { align: 'end' }, }), columnHelper.accessor('signedUp', { cell: ({ getValue }) => dateFormat.format(new Date(getValue())), enableGlobalFilter: false, header: 'Signed up', meta: { align: 'end' }, sortDescFirst: true, }), ]) const DataTable6 = (props: DataTable6Props) => { const { onEmail = openMailto, onExport = downloadCsv, pageSize = 8, rows = noRows, status, title, } = props const { description = summarize(rows) } = props const table = useDataTable({ columns, data: rows, getRowId: (row) => row.id, initialState: { columnVisibility: { seats: false }, sorting: [{ desc: true, id: 'mrr' }], }, pageSize, }) const selected = table.getSelectedRowModel().rows.map((row) => row.original) return (

{title}

{description}
{selected.length > 0 ? ( ) : ( <>
)}
) } export { DataTable6, exampleProps as dataTable6ExampleProps, type DataTable6Props }
